items.title: 6.3.1.2 Web Hosting and Content Delivery (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Cloud computing websites host karne (internet par chalane) aur duniya bhar ke users tak content tezi se pohanchane ke liye zaroori infrastructure deti hai.

Misal (Example): Amazon Web Services (AWS) aur Microsoft Azure jaise platforms web hosting deti hain, jis se karobar apni websites cloud servers par chalate hain. Cloudflare jaise content delivery networks (CDNs) website ka content users ke qareeb wale servers par cache (aarzi copy rakhna) kar ke use jaldi pohanchate hain.

blocks.prompt: CDN website ko tez kyun khol deta hai?
blocks.explanation: CDN content ki copies user ke qareeb wale servers par rakhta hai, is liye data ko kam faasla tay karna parta hai aur page jaldi khulta hai.

items: Cloud servers par web hosting (AWS, Azure).
CDN (Cloudflare) content users ke qareeb cache karta hai.
